traceability.title: 40+ utleieobjekter (skalerbart antall)
traceability.evidence: No hardcoded limits. Database supports unlimited listings. Pagination implemented.

traceability.title: Demo: testbrukere for roller
traceability.evidence: Seed data includes User, CaseHandler, Admin roles. 15 listings, bookings seeded.

traceability.title: Brukerperspektiv (mobil-first, oppgavebasert)
traceability.evidence: API supports mobile clients. Frontend responsibility. Booking wizard needs validation.

traceability.title: Sikker autentisering (ID-porten)
traceability.evidence: Auth flow implemented. ID-porten adapter in SDK. Not connected to production IdP.

traceability.title: Avbooking/kansellering innen frist
traceability.evidence: PUT /api/bookings/:id/cancel endpoint. Cancellation policy per listing in rules. Audit logging.

traceability.title: Gjentakende leie (recurring bookings)
traceability.evidence: Allocations support recurring patterns. Booking recurrence schema exists but not fully implemented.

traceability.title: Sesongleie
traceability.evidence: Full CRUD for seasonal leases. Blocks availability. Audit events.

traceability.title: Enkeltarrangementer/møter
traceability.evidence: Bookings support event metadata. isPublic flag for public calendar.

traceability.title: Betaling ved booking
traceability.evidence: Payment adapter interface exists. Vipps mock in SDK. Production integration pending.

traceability.title: Universell utforming (WCAG 2.1 AA)
traceability.evidence: Designsystemet (Digdir) used. axe-core in test setup. Full audit pending.

traceability.title: Verifisering av orgnr (Brønnøysund)
traceability.evidence: Integration adapter interface exists. Brønnøysund API not connected.

traceability.title: Lese og godkjenne vilkår
traceability.evidence: Listing metadata.rules stored. Terms acceptance in booking flow. Versioned terms support.

traceability.title: Offentlig aktivitetskalender
traceability.evidence: GET /api/public/calendar. Widget embeds available. isPublic filter.

traceability.title: Tilleggstjenester (add-ons)
traceability.evidence: Add-on services in listing schema. Pricing rules support add-ons.

traceability.title: Regler per lokale
traceability.evidence: Listing metadata.rules. booking_time_policies table. Age/approval requirements.

traceability.title: Kommunen kan avlyse og varsle
traceability.evidence: Admin cancellation with reason. Notification sent. Audit logged.

traceability.title: Prisregler
traceability.evidence: Price rules per listing. User group discounts. Time-based pricing.

traceability.title: Regelstyrt forslag til sesongfordeling (SHOULD)
traceability.evidence: Not implemented. Future feature.

traceability.title: Rapporter/utnyttelsesgrad (SHOULD)
traceability.evidence: Reports endpoint with utilization, revenue. Dashboard KPIs.

traceability.title: Salgsbilag iht bokføringskrav
traceability.evidence: Booking details include who/what/where/when. Export pending.

traceability.title: Låssystemintegrasjon (RCO)
traceability.evidence: RCO adapter in xala-sdk. Mock available. Access control logging.

traceability.title: Økonomiintegrasjon (Visma) - SHOULD
traceability.evidence: Visma adapter interface exists with mock. Production integration pending.

traceability.title: Arkivintegrasjon (Acos WebSak)
traceability.evidence: Acos adapter interface exists with mock. Metadata export available.

traceability.title: Outlook-kalenderintegrasjon (SHOULD)
traceability.evidence: Google/Outlook calendar sync adapters. OAuth flow.

traceability.title: GDPR-etterlevelse + dokumentasjon
traceability.evidence: Audit logging. GDPR consent module in SDK. Data export endpoints.

traceability.title: Personvern innebygd og som standard
traceability.evidence: RBAC enforced. Tenant isolation. Minimal data collection. Audit trail.

traceability.title: Registrertes rettigheter
traceability.evidence: User data export endpoint. Soft delete available. Consent management.

traceability.title: Opplæringsplan + hjelpeverktøy
traceability.evidence: Documentation exists. In-app help not implemented.

traceability.title: Support på norsk
traceability.evidence: Norwegian i18n throughout. Error messages in Norwegian.

traceability.title: Brukerstøtte for innbyggere (SHOULD)
traceability.evidence: FAQ pending. Contact form not implemented.

traceability.title: Data lagres i EU/EØS
traceability.evidence: Hostinger VPS in Netherlands (EU). PostgreSQL on same server.

traceability.title: Driftspersonell i EU/EØS
traceability.evidence: All developers in Norway (EU/EØS).

traceability.title: Sertifiseringer
traceability.evidence: No formal ISO certification. Following security best practices.

traceability.title: Dokumentert IKT-sikkerhet
traceability.evidence: Security headers implemented. Policies documentation pending.

traceability.title: Kryptering av data
traceability.evidence: TLS 1.3 in transit. Database encrypted at rest (Hostinger).

traceability.evidence: HTTPS enforced. TLS 1.2/1.3. SSL Labs A rating target.

traceability.title: Databehandleravtale
traceability.evidence: Template available. Needs customer-specific signing process.

traceability.title: Sikker filopplasting
traceability.evidence: File type allowlist. Size limits. Storage on media.digilist.no.

traceability.title: Varsling ved sikkerhetsbrudd
traceability.evidence: Audit logging captures events. Incident response process needs documentation.

traceability.title: Planlagt vedlikehold varsling
traceability.evidence: Email notifications possible. Status page not implemented.

traceability.title: Sikkerhetsrevisjon mulig
traceability.evidence: Audit logs exportable. Third-party access can be granted.

traceability.title: SSL Labs + SecurityHeaders rating
traceability.evidence: SSL Labs: A. SecurityHeaders: B+. All security headers configured.

traceability.title: Periodiske sårbarhetsskanninger
traceability.evidence: External scanning allowed. No rate limiting on security research.

traceability.title: Dataeksport ved terminering
traceability.evidence: Full data export via API. PostgreSQL dump available.

traceability.title: Ansvar ved datatap
traceability.evidence: Daily backups. SLA documentation pending.

traceability.title: Ikke stenge ved betalingskonflikt
traceability.evidence: No automatic service termination. Grace period policy.

traceability.title: Backupfrekvens + restore
traceability.evidence: Daily PostgreSQL dumps. Manual restore tested.

traceability.title: Segregering av kundedata
traceability.evidence: Tenant ID on all tables. API enforces tenant isolation.

traceability.evidence: TenantAdmin/Admin can manage users. RBAC with role assignment.

traceability.title: MFA-støtte
traceability.evidence: MFA via ID-porten when connected. Local auth lacks MFA.
